contract: For each panel visit, receive the cached first batch when its feed starts, including when start emits synchronously, and continue receiving live deltas while that visit is selected. After selection changes or the panel hides, prevent rows or counts from a previous visit from becoming visible, including when the same feed object is reused and decode or paint completes later. A count may become visible only after its corresponding rows have finished painting and only if that visit is still current. Preserve history for every batch already received by the panel subscriber once decoding completes, even if the visit has ended; detachment stops new reception but does not revoke accepted work. Preserve public APIs, payloads, host rendering behavior, and the independent metrics consumer’s policy. Account for callbacks that run inline and painting that synchronously navigates or hides; no particular repair strategy is required.

unknowns: No evidence establishes shared work with lazy cancellation, attempt-local cancellation resources, or a deferred persistence boundary.
